_note: Saved parties: build doc builds (by number) with their gear changes, and variants for the trade-offs worked out for them. Notes are the takeaways

parties.name: My Tactician party (Godblade, Hexwing Phantom, Deathreaper, Arcane Deadeye)
notes: Godblade gloves: Spellmight (+23 a round, +35 with the Resonance Stone) > Helldusk (+22) > Dark Justiciar (+15). Legacy of the Masters (+34) and the +1 to hit gauntlets (Blackguard's, Warmaster, Unwanted Masterwork) need Medium Armour proficiency: they end Mage Armour and Bladesong, AC 27 -> 20
Spellmight Gloves only add to Booming Blade: +1d8 thunder and +1d8 weapon damage, and no -5 (it rolls a weapon attack, not a spell attack)
Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength do nothing at Dexterity 22. Gloves of Battlemage's Power only raise spell attacks and DC, no weapon damage
Necklace of Elemental Augmentation doesn't trigger on Booming Blade
Rhapsody at +3 (after 3 kills a long rest) beats Belm by about 40 a round and adds +3 spell DC. Belm is ahead only before the third kill

Elixirs: Bloodlust when you aim kills to trigger it (about +64 for the Godblade); Cloud Giant Strength against a single boss in Act 3 (+46; before Act 3 only Hill Giant Strength, which does nothing at Dexterity 22), and on any Strength build (doubled with Balduran's Giantslayer); the Deathreaper takes Battlemage's Power when it casts Hold Person

Hold Person / Hold Monster: a held target lifts the party from 449 to 704 a round (611 to 1,025 with the stone); each +1 DC is worth about 13 party damage a round. The Deathreaper (DC 21) should cast it: the Godblade casting it ends its own Haste (Lethargic)
Broodmother's Revenge + Ring of Regeneration: the ring heals every turn, even at full HP, so the poison coating stays up: +22 a round in place of the Band of the Mystic Scoundrel
Wavemother's Cloak: +2 AC and saves each turn until damaged. The Godblade is already only hit on a 20, so the saves are the gain
An Eldritch Knight Shadow Blade build ties the Godblade's damage (ahead with the stone) but has AC 20 and needs someone else's Haste
As played: Dexterity 22, Bless from an ally, the Drakethroat Glaive's elemental weapon and Rapture (about +18 to hit), Shadow Blade with advantage in dim light about half the time
Amulet of Greater Health (Constitution 23) is worth more than its HP: Constitution saves keep Haste up. Broodmother's Revenge + Ring of Regeneration costs it and the Caustic Band

variants.name: Gloves: Legacy of the Masters (the Deadeye's; ends Mage Armour and Bladesong)
Gloves: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength
Off hand: Belm instead of Rhapsody
